observation: Anchor is in the refine band (proxy 0.589). Stages 1-3 look healthy for a t3 continuous scan: orient_axis_corr -0.999 with the invariant passing, recentre residual 10.2 cm (only marginally above the 10 cm gate), denoise retention 0.74, depth NaN 14% (below the ~19-22% family-normal level). Ring count is exact (10 verticals for 10 rings) and the K-row gate propagated 10 prompts at a single consistent y (~1560 px), so the vertical pattern and the K row are found. The weak feature is correspondence_f1@15 = 0.287: in detected_lines.png only ~8 short oblique K-edge segments (rings 4-10 only; rings 1-3 on the left have none) plus three very short horizontals were detected, while the A/B longitudinal joints at y~800 and y~2300 appear in the outlier map only as sparse dotted rows and yield no long lines. In the SC overlay almost every horizontal label boundary is red (unsupported) and the few K-edge lines are orange because they sit ~15-25 px from the template edges. The template layout itself (K ~165 px tall = 824 mm, tapered K edges at 4-8 deg, AB boundaries spaced ~670 px) matches the visible joint periodicity, so this is a line-yield problem, not a geometry problem. Ring pitch measured from the verticals is ~245 px (~1.22 m) vs a 1200 mm segment_width template, leaving thin unlabeled gutters between ring columns (fill rate 0.70).
rule: ontology d7 (m_line_yield low, horizontal fallback firing) -> f_missing_lines; remediation r_relax_hough (lower oblique/horizontal thresholds, raise maxLineGap) after ruling out upstream f_joint_oversmoothed / f_depth_holes (NaN 14% and visible dotted joint rows show the joints are present but under-sampled in the binarised outlier map, so relax binarisation too). experiences.md section 7: stages 1-3 validated first, then detection, then SAM; section 5: keep vertical count == ring count, so hough_threshold_vertical is left untouched.
failure_mode: f_missing_lines (stage_4_detection) with a minor f_over_under_coverage contribution from segment_width slightly narrower than the measured ring pitch.
rationale: Round 1 targets the weakest lean feature (correspondence F1) by raising true-joint line yield: a lower binary_threshold (127 -> 110) keeps the faint dotted outlier pixels along the A/B joints, lower oblique/horizontal Hough thresholds (30 -> 24) let the left rings' K edges and the y~800 / y~2300 joint rows reach the accumulator, and a larger oblique maxLineGap (30 -> 45) bridges the dotted rows into long segments that can be matched to the label boundaries. Thresholds are kept moderate (not the 20 floor) to limit spurious lines on the bolt-hole rows that sit ~80-100 px from the K edges. The K-row snap and the vertical accumulator are unchanged so ring_count_error stays 0 and the prompt row stays pinned. segment_width is nudged 1200 -> 1220 mm to match the ~1.22 m ring pitch and close the inter-column gutters, a small fill-rate gain. Unfolding is deliberately not touched: the residual is only 0.2 cm over the gate, orientation is pinned, and re-rolling stage 1 would confound attribution of the detection change.
